 versus

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Neena Bansal Krishna
 Order

Petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, has been filed on behalf of the Petitioners for challenging the Order dated 20.03.2025 whereby the Petitioners were summoned for the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, though they were discharged under Section 406 IPC.

This Order has been upheld by the learned ASJ vide Order dated 14.10.2025.
2.
3. On advance Notice, learned APP for the State has appeared.

4. On taking steps, Notice of the Petition be issued to the Respondent No. 2/Complainant through the Investigating Officer including through ordinary post and electronic mode, returnable on 25.03.2026.
5.
